{{Quote|I shall slay you one and all, Skywalker included, replacing you with cybernetically enhanced drones grown from your own tissues and implanted with facsimiles of your own memories.|Zeta Magnus revealing his plans|<ref name="swcw" />}}
A '''clone''' of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was created by the mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] during the early [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Origins===
{{Quote|You psychotic extremists, always &hellip; playing god.|Anakin Skywalker to Zeta Magnus|<ref name="swcw" />}}
In the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] preceding the Clone Wars, the [[mutant]] Zeta Magnus escaped his [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Techno-lord|creators]] and wandered the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Shortly after he discovered his creators had programmed an expiration  into his genetic code, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] approached him with an offer of [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] in exchange for his fealty. While Zeta agreed to lend his genetic talents to Sidious and his subordinates, he didn't trust him at all and planned to kill the Dark Lord if he failed to uphold his promise. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] Zeta Magnus plagued the [[S'kytri]] people and declared himself the [[Magister of Skye|Magister]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]] in order to provoke a response from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] per Sidious' orders. When [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Commander [[Halagad Ventor]] were dispatched to stop him, Darth Sidious authorized the killing of Kenobi and Ventor. He wanted Magnus to spare Skywalker so he could flourish under his guidance when he returned from Skye. Zeta Magnus ultimately decided to annul this agreement with the Dark Lord and began making preparations to work against him. Before the Jedi left for their mission, Zeta Magnus used his agents to acquire analysis-grade blood and tissue samples of Kenobi and Anakin from a restricted medical source.<ref name="swcw" />

===Creation===
{{Quote|It can't be&hellip;|Anakin Skywalker upon seeing his clone|<ref name="swcw" />}}
In the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] of his opulent [[Kharys' fortress|fortress]] atop the [[Canaitith Mountain]] on Skye, Zeta Magnus began to grow a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of Anakin and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (clone)|Obi-Wan]]. Zeta used modified Arkanian [[GeNode]] cloning technology in conjunction with forgotten [[Rapid cloning|Jedi cloning techniques]] he acquired from the abandoned cloning lab under the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to create two stable clones of the Jedi in mere [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. By the time Anakin, Obi-Wan, and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Halagad Ventor reached the fortress and were captured, the clones had grown to the equivalent age of ten standard years. Since the clones were nothing more than mindless husks, Zeta Magnus placed [[Mindscan droid]]s on the Jedi's heads to scan their minds. Once their scans were complete, the droids would [[Flash pumping|flash-pump]] all of the Jedi's memories to their clone's minds. To ensure the clone's loyalty and subservience, [[cyber-mnemonic implant]]ations would be installed that gave Zeta Magnus total control over their minds and turned them into obedient drones. Since the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] count of the clones were the same as their templates, Zeta Magnus would have two fully trained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Jedi at his disposal.

===Destruction===
{{Quote|I TOLD YOU, ANAKIN! NO DISINTEG—''"<br />"''That wasn't me!''"|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker after the clone's destruction|<ref name="swcw" />}}     
Upon seeing the clone of himself floating in a vat, Anakin boiled with confusion, animalistic horror, anger, revulsion, and sadness. Zeta Magnus revealed that he had been instructed to kill Kenobi and Ventor so young Skywalker could flourish under his benefactor's guidance. Instead of killing the two Jedi and returning the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]] to Darth Sidious, Zeta planned to create three obedient Jedi slaves and return a clone of Anakin to Sidious. While Anakin served as Sidious's confidant, the Sith Lord would be ignorant to the fact that his protégé was actually a clone [[Spy/Legends|agent]] of Zeta Magnus.
Once the mind scans were complete, Zeta Magnus prepared to execute the three Jedi with his [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]]. The Force-sensitive S'kytri [[Kharys]] used the Force from outside the laboratory window to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] the mutant's blade so it struck the torture droid that was preventing the restrained Jedi from using the Force. Once the Jedi freed themselves they began to fight Zeta Magnus and his four [[Thyrsian]] [[Tark Squad|clones]]. The identical midi-chlorian signature of Anakin's clone interrupted his connection to the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] and hampered his focus during combat. Zeta Magnus's commandos attempted to throw a [[Class-D detonator]] at the Jedi's position, but it prematurely detonated by Ventor with the Force. The [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] [[Thermal detonator/Legends|detonator]] [[Class-D annihilation|annihilated]] the area of the lab where the commandos stood and disintegrated the clones of Anakin and Obi-Wan.<ref name="swcw" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone of Anakin Skywalker first appeared in the novella [[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]] by [[Abel G. Peña|Abel G. Pena]].
